title: GIMP
summary: GIMP is a free, open-source raster graphics editor used for photo retouching, image editing, and format conversion. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. The application supports plugins and scripting for task automation. Development occurs in a public Git repository managed by a volunteer community, with new features merged into the main branch only after review. GIMP is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later and available in 84 languages.

mechanisms.title: Public Git repository and branch-based development
mechanisms.explanation: GIMP's source code is hosted in a public Git repository. New features are developed in separate branches and merged into the main branch only after the development team confirms they will not damage existing functions. This process can delay feature availability by months or years.

mechanisms.title: Plugin and scripting support
mechanisms.explanation: GIMP allows users to extend its functionality and automate tasks through plugins and scripting. The application is programmable using Python and Scheme, among other languages.
